text:
dario: flipped predictive-KV-evict + smooth-microbatcher to prod @ 11:03 PT. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% gradual ramp, canary metrics looked stable.

deploy-bot: deploy started: commit a9f3e11 -> prod | canary=5% -> 25% -> 100% | sha a9f3e11 | eta 00:21:00

maya: quick post-1h summary from perf board: p50 -12%, p95 -38%, p99 -29%, cost per 1k tokens -26%. numbers below.

maya: ```
baseline: {p50: 95ms, p95: 260ms, p99: 560ms, cost_per_1k: $0.048} 
after:    {p50: 84ms, p95: 162ms, p99: 398ms, cost_per_1k: $0.036}
```

tim: breakdown: tiny/short (<=64) saw ~30% cost drop; medium (65-512) ~22%; long-context (>1024) p99 improved ~15% but cost delta ~8%.

dario: tl;dr on changes: predictive-KV-evict keeps likely-needed KV shards in L0 for sessions predicted to continue, reducing fetch misses. smooth-microbatcher uses jittered timers + dynamic windowing to merge concurrent low-latency requests without batch clumping. latency ceiling set to 8ms to limit added wait.

runtime-oncall: infra notes: minor queue bump at 25% step (~50s) but smoothed out. autoscaler triggered an extra node during a transient surge then scaled down. saw 2x 503s from internal LB that were retried successfully by client side. no GPU OOMs.

eng-sre: please add a short rollback criterion to the runbook: revert if p99 > baseline by 10% for 15m after rollout. filing INF-9642.

dario: noted and added runbook patch PR #4812. also adding an alert: queue_length > 140 for >1m post-deploy.

anna: product/CS wants a one-paragraph summary + 1-line FAQ about long-context caveats. suggested blurb: "Most customers should see ~20-30% lower inference costs and significantly improved p95 latency for short/medium contexts. Very long-context workloads will benefit at p99 but may see smaller unit-cost reductions. Contact support for model-specific guidance."

maya: uploaded perf graphs: https://internal.redwood/perf/graphs/1799998887 (internal only).

dario: scheduling a dedicated-pool canary next Tue 09:30 PT to validate reserved capacity behavior under bursty traffic, invite sent.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: commit a9f3e11 -> prod | status=success | duration=00:29:03 :rocket:

runtime-oncall: continuing to monitor 72h. will escalate in this thread if p99 regresses beyond the rollback threshold. great job team :tada:
